question: Independent judge B, 26.09, action 6 (+1 on 8.1): on set O about 80 object-frames with points inside the envelope get no alert of any kind; the 2 x 2 m box at the envelope top (#8, big_above) STOPs in 12 of 124 frames and is CAUTION-only at 0-50 m (17 advisory frames, 0 STOP); the edge box (#6, big_edge_inside) reads GO in its 8 in-envelope frames. Candidate: an advisory (warning-zone / demoted) object with enough voxels N inside the strict envelope within D m, confirmed over the usual frames, becomes a STOP. Why does #6 get no alert, and can a near-field rule catch it without #5 / #7 and without ride false STOPs?

preregistration.before: any candidate run on real data (the flags are written but only the ray-cast unit tests have run them)
preregistration.rule: tracking.near_escalate_voxels N > 0: a track whose last near_escalate_hits K hits were each a corridor cluster (kind '') with >= N voxels inside the strict envelope (Cluster.n_gauge, edge margin applied) at <= near_escalate_distance D m is zone gauge (STOP), whatever demoted it (a signature, the zone vote); a cluster demoted as a column never counts, and a track held advisory by tracking.column_hold stays advisory. Detection.reason 'near_envelope' marks it. Default off (N = 0): output byte-identical

candidates_in_order.name: D (#6)
candidates_in_order.run_if: always, on top of the shipped one of A / B / C (alone if none ships)
candidates_in_order.rule: a cluster the wall-at-the-side rule would drop (taller than 1.9 m, centroid > 1.2 m off the axis) is kept when it has >= 10 strict voxels and starts within 20 m; the signatures (column, ...) and the other infrastructure rules still apply

preregistration.procedure: per candidate: the six recordings + set O first (the gate on a cache without the ride, --allow 'ride.*' --allow 'set_F_straight.*'); if that passes, the full gate (--jobs 1) against regression_baseline_2026-09-25_ride_p3b.json
preregistration.ship_rule: the first of A / B / C (in order) that satisfies all of: (1) full gate exit 0, no gated row worse; (2) set O STOP frames on the inside objects up; (3) no new false STOP frame on #5, #7 or the background (set O background alarm frames and ids); (4) ride STOP episodes and alarm events not up. D ships on top of it only if it satisfies (1)-(4) with #6's STOP frames up. If none passes: nothing ships, the flags stay off
preregistration.safety_conditions: identical or better, else no ship whatever the gate says: doubleT_obstacle labelled hits per label and first alarm frame; set O first STOP distance and frame of every inside object; set F straight detections per kind (sequences detected, median first-confirmation distance)
preregistration.baseline_note: if it ships and numbers move, the gate baseline is not re-cut here (the integrator will)
